_comment: Paths (relative to the scaffolded frontend/) to delete when mode === 'b2c'. The boilerplate ships every view by default; b2c shops trim the b2b-only ones. NOTE: trimming a view file leaves the router still importing it — propeller-vue's router names every view in an explicit `() => import('@/views/…')`, so the matching routes are removed by overlay-b2c/src/router/index.ts.textpatch.json. (This manifest previously claimed routes were folder-imported and deletion alone sufficed; it wasn't true — vue-tsc failed with TS2307 on all six views.)
